scripts.docker:run: docker run --env-file template.env boriskorobkov/recipe-count:dev php src/index.php
scripts.docker:unit-tests-xdebug: docker run -v $(pwd):/var/www -v $(pwd)/docker/php-xdebug.ini:/usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/php-xdebug.ini -e PHP_IDE_CONFIG="serverName=recipeCount" --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway boriskorobkov/recipe-count:dev /bin/sh -c 'XDEBUG_SESSION=1 php tests/unit/index.php'
